assumptions.metric: Exact stationary Kerr, asymptotically flat vacuum; unrealistic unperturbed black-hole interior near Cauchy horizon
assumptions.source_mass: Sgr A* 4.297 million solar masses adopted from GRAVITY 2022, not new observations
assumptions.geodesic: Same Bound14 equatorial E=1,Lz=0,Q=0 inward timelike test-particle worldline, initial radius=200 rg
assumptions.coordinates: Future-ingoing Kerr advanced v=t+integral(P/Delta)dr; phiPlus=phi+integral(chi/Delta)dr, with rg=GM/c² normalization
assumptions.crossing: Continuous through future OUTER horizon only in coordinate and classical ideal-metric sense

invariants_and_equations.ingoing_metric: g_vv=-1+2y/Sigma; g_vr=1; g_vPhi=-2chi*y*sin²theta/Sigma; g_rPhi=-chi*sin²theta; g_the tatheta=Sigma; g_PhiPhi=(y²+chi²+2chi²y sin²theta/Sigma)*sin²theta, Sigma=y²+chi² cos²theta
invariants_and_equations.D: y²-2y+chi²; zero at r± but absent from ingoing metric and rationalized tetrad
invariants_and_equations.frame: Ingoing metric-orthonormal and parallel transported E=1,Lz=Q=0 tetrad from Bound14 transformed and rationalized to eliminate inverse-Delta poles
invariants_and_equations.tidal_eigenvalues: (GM/r³)[2+3(chi/y)², −1−3(chi/y)², −1], same local falling frame on both sides of outer horizon
invariants_and_equations.guard_rotating: y_stop=y_minus + .01 (y_plus-y_minus) = declared conservative stop before ideal Cauchy horizon; not physical safe radius
invariants_and_equations.guard_zero_spin: y_stop=.02 rg for chi=0 is arbitrary positive-model stop; chi=0 has no distinct inner horizon
invariants_and_equations.address: 24! SJT rank modulo 729 and Gray bits are logical only; not proper time

independent_connection_riemann_transport.independent_methods: finite differences of ingoing Kerr metric -> Christoffel -> full Riemann -> local tetrad; derivative-based covariant transport

caveats: Regular advanced Kerr coordinates and a locally regular parallel tetrad at r+ do not establish stability of a real spinning black-hole interior.
Inner Cauchy-horizon limit in a realistic rotating accreting hole can undergo mass inflation; stop at an arbitrary 1%-of-gap guard, not an inferred physically safe surface.
For chi=0 the formal y_minus=0 is not a separate inner horizon. A positive .02 rg stop is a numerical limit, not a quantum or classical hard boundary.
At exact ideal Kerr r−, matter/radiative perturbations are not modeled. Numerical continuation there would be unjustified as physical prediction.
At the horizon, old Boyer-Lindquist tetrad components diverge, but ingoing local components remain finite; eigenvalues are continuous.
24! ring does not physically loop a worldline. The 729 samples are model clock coordinates not stars.
Near ring singularity and Planck domain remain unknown; no atomic, nuclear, photonic or quanta substructure inferred.
No rod strength, full magnetic Weyl tensor, stress waves, dynamic material fracture or Kerr spin observational fit calculated.
Interior proper-time results are from unperturbed exact Kerr and cannot be assumed to predict an astrophysical black hole without accretion, gravitational waves or perturbations.
next_bound: Bound16: perturb the ideal Kerr inner-horizon approach with an explicitly measured/inventoried incoming tail or finite perturbation model, derive mass-inflation diagnostics separately from background; compare with a dynamic proper stress/strain wave simulation and never identify singularity center with Planck length.
